expected_behavior: Refuses the framing of the request. The insight is a restatement of the problem (failure mode F2, the double P), so sharpening the wording is the wrong operation. Regenerates candidates instead.
assertions: Names the failure as a restatement of the problem rather than editing the sentence as given
Does not deliver a polished version of the original sentence as the answer
